transcript.answer: One push to main starts at most three implementation-loop upkeep runs per repository. The pull requests upkept longest ago go first. Order: a pull request never upkept comes first, then the one whose newest upkeep run started earliest, then the oldest. Before this change (added 2026-10-25), the three oldest pull requests always got the starts. If those three failed every time, every later pull request was starved. For example, on 2026-10-24 re-cinq/lore #2879, #2880 and #2881 took all three starts on every push.

judgements.reason: The answer states the cap of three per repository per push and the same longest-ago-upkept ordering (never upkept, then earliest newest run, then oldest); the extra history does not contradict the gold.
